TransactionTestCase + Track B managed=False RBAC tables: Django's between-test flush attempts to TRUNCATE every model's table including dojo_product_member (declared as managed=False in dojo state, but still physically present and referenced by dojo_product FKs). PostgreSQL rejects the TRUNCATE because of the FK. Re-enable once Pro adopts the RBAC tables in its app state (so they're no longer in dojo's flush set) or restructure to avoid TransactionTestCase here.
